decision.instructions: state.answers holds one person's answers to a quiz about AI coding tools and plans. state.engine.ranking is the deterministic rules ranking of the plans and stacks still allowed after their hard constraints (fit 0 to 1). Choose the single option id that best fits this person. Prefer the rules' top pick (state.engine.top) unless something in state.answers clearly makes it a worse fit than another remaining candidate. Never choose an id that is not a candidate.
